remarks.zh: 计算柜子的板材尺寸。[宽度]、[高度]、[深度] 是总体尺寸，[板厚] 是顶部、底部和侧面板的厚度，[背板厚度] 是背板的厚度。(AI translated, please check)
remarks.en: Calculates board sizes for a cabinet. [Width], [Height], [Depth] is total Measurement, [BoardThick] is Top, Bottom and Side Board material thickness, [BackBoardThick] is Background Board material thickness.
remarks.ms: Mengira saiz papan untuk kabinet. [Lebar], [Tinggi], [Kedalaman] adalah ukuran keseluruhan, [KetebalanPapan] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Atas, Bawah dan Sisi, [KetebalanPapanBelakang] adalah ketebalan bahan papan latar belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.id: Menghitung ukuran papan untuk kabinet. [Lebar], [Tinggi], [Kedalaman] adalah ukuran total, [KetebalanPapan] adalah ketebalan bahan papan Atas, Bawah, dan Samping, [KetebalanPapanBelakang] adalah ketebalan bahan papan belakang. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.th: คำนวณขนาดของแผ่นไม้สำหรับตู้ [ความกว้าง], [ความสูง], [ความลึก] คือขนาดรวม, [ความหนาแผ่นไม้] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นไม้ด้านบน ด้านล่าง และด้านข้าง, [ความหนาแผ่นหลัง] คือความหนาของวัสดุแผ่นหลัง (AI translated, please check)
remarks.vi: Tính toán kích thước ván cho tủ. [Chiều rộng], [Chiều cao], [Chiều sâu] là kích thước tổng, [Độ dày ván] là độ dày của vật liệu ván trên, dưới và bên hông, [Độ dày ván sau] là độ dày của vật liệu ván nền. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.tl: Kinakalkula ang mga sukat ng tabla para sa kabinet. [Lapad], [Taas], [Lalim] ay kabuuang Mga Sukat, [Kapal ng Tabla] ay kapal ng materyal ng Itaas, Ilalim at Gilid na Tabla, [Kapal ng Back Board] ay kapal ng materyal ng Back Board. (AI translated, please check)
remarks.my: စင်တစ်ခုအတွက် ကြမ်းခင်းသစ်သားအရွယ်အစားများကိုတွက်ချက်သည်။ [အနံ့၊ [အမြင့်]၊ [အနက်] သည်စုစုပေါင်းတိုင်းတာမှုဖြစ်ကြောင်း၊ [ဘုတ်အထူ] သည်ထိပ်ပိုင်း၊ အောက်ပိုင်းနှင့်ဘေးဘုတ်ပစ္စည်းအထူ၊ [BackBoardThick] သည်နောက်ခံဘုတ်ပစ္စည်းအထူဖြစ်သည်။ (AI translated, please check)
remarks.km: គណនាតួលេខបន្ទះសម្រាប់ទូ។ [ទទឹង] [កម្ពស់] កម្ពស់ជាលេខសរុប [ធំជ្រៅបន្ទះ] គឺជាតួលេខសម្រាប់ធំ [បន្ថែម](AI translated, please check)
